title: AIO OPC UA Device Inbound Endpoint Additional Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the additional configuration of OPC UA inbound endpoint of an device in Azure Industrial Operations

applicationName.description: Name that is used if AIO OPC UA Connector needs to create own (self-signed) certificate

keepAliveMilliseconds.description: Keep alive interval, to maintain session between OPC UA server and AIO OPC UA Connector

publishingIntervalMilliseconds.description: Default interval used to send value changes from OPC UA server to AIO OPC UA Connector

samplingIntervalMilliseconds.description: Default interval used to sample values of observed datapoints on the OPC UA server

queueSize.description: Default size of the queue that contains datapoint value changes on the OPC UA server

keyFrameCount.description: Default multiplier of the `publishing interval`, defines which value change should be a keyframe (contains all values, even if they haven't changed)

timeoutMilliseconds.description: Time after which the session is closed if there was no message from the OPC UA server

keepAliveIntervalMilliseconds.description: Keep alive interval, to maintain session between OPC UA server and AIO OPC UA Connector

reconnectPeriodMilliseconds.description: Default waiting time used in between session reconnects

reconnectExponentialBackOffMilliseconds.description: Exponential backoff time used during session reconnects

enableTracingHeaders.description: Send W3C tracing information along with OPC UA service calls

maxItems.description: Maximum number of datapoints/events added to one subscription

lifeTimeMilliseconds.description: Time after which the subscription is closed if there was no message from the OPC UA server

securityPolicy.description: Security policy used to establish secure channel with the OPC UA server

securityMode.description: Security mode used to communicate within secure channel with the OPC UA server

runAssetDiscovery.description: Automatically run OPC UA asset discovery every 10min

syncPropertiesIntoStateStore.description: Read properties of datapoints and write them into AIO MQTT Distributed State Store

shared.description: Whether the endpoint profile is shared across multiple connectors
